fieldValues.policy_explanation: The item carries a technical plan: a "## Technical plan" section, or at least three concrete steps (a checklist or numbered list) with code references or acceptance criteria. Issues already written with detailed steps carry their plan without the heading. The owner directing the work does not earn this grade on its own: agents run as the owner's actor, so the session actor cannot prove the owner is present (clerk#157 review, B1).
